metaDescription: Open a sitemap.xml.gz in your browser: unzip, read formatted XML, count URLs and save as plain .xml. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Opens a gzipped sitemap file, shows the XML formatted, counts the URLs and lets you save the plain .xml.
why:
Many sites publish sitemap.xml.gz, which you cannot read in an editor. Command line tools work, but not everyone has one at hand.

This tool uses the decompression built into your browser. It also accepts a plain .xml file. Very long files show the first 1,500 lines, and the download has everything.
howTo: Read the size before and after unzipping and the URL count.
Save the plain XML file if needed.
